observation: An adversarial implementation review found that P0v2 fixed bundles did not retain the issued finite forecast laws, search bundles did not retain validation laws/outcomes, algorithmic seeds sharing the same market outcomes were treated as independent bootstrap clusters, local qualification receipts could satisfy the environment gate, policy arrays conflated pre-return targets with post-return holdings, and the causal MLP trained against a residual-shifted law mean. No S12 official archive, market fit, search cell, fixed cell, Kaggle scientific session or protected outcome had been accessed.
hypothesized_cause: The first implementation encoded the headline workflow but left independent reconstruction, dependence-aware inference and target-platform admission less strict than the written evidence boundary.
change: Freeze P0v3 without changing the hypothesis, data, cells, controls, thresholds or budgets. Retain complete search/fixed forecast laws and outcomes; separate targets from holdings; average algorithmic seeds before equal-family/equal-fold inference; resample folds and 12-month blocks; aggregate variogram means before the relative guard; train the MLP against its raw causal mean; require an exact-source Kaggle-scientific admission receipt and conservatively measured generated workload projection; keep GPU unadmitted without equivalence and speedup evidence.
predicted_effect: Every reported score can be reconstructed from raw retained laws, repeated seeds cannot inflate the market sample size, policy accounting is auditable, and neither a local receipt nor an unmeasured Kaggle host can unlock scientific execution.
discriminating_experiment: Warnings-as-errors tests must reconstruct fold and search scores, prove bit-exact resume with retained laws and policy paths, verify seed-first aggregation and local-receipt rejection, pass strict typing/lint/build/clean-wheel checks, and preserve a new no-overwrite generated artifact under the final source identity. The actual Kaggle qualification must still run and pass before data/search execution.
retained_build_packaging_attempt: The first P0v3 build succeeded but omitted the embedded v3 amendment because package-data listed only P0v2. That temporary build remains under /tmp and was superseded before delivery by a wheel whose inventory contains both protocols.
